scope: Normalized requirement inventory; the competition rules and Kaggle contact control if requirements differ during closeout.

requirements: Well-written English Word or PDF unless otherwise approved
Competition, team, score, rank and team-member information
Team background and contributions
Four-to-six-sentence method summary
Features or equivalent model inputs and transformations
Training methods and ensemble weighting
Important findings and differentiators
Simplified-model tradeoff where relevant
Training and prediction execution times
References and external sources
Single archive containing all code, non-Kaggle data and trained model artifacts needed for reproduction
Top-level README.md with exact hardware, platform, third-party software, install, train, predict, side-effect and assumption details
Configuration files and placement instructions
Top-level requirements.txt with exact package versions or an exact-version Dockerfile
Top-level directory_structure.txt
SETTINGS.json as the single source for train, test, model and output paths
Serialized trained model and documented checkpoint location
entry_points.md with data-preparation, training and prediction commands
Well-commented code that reproduces the leaderboard result within a reasonable margin
standard_components.notebook_only_note: For a notebook-only competition, share the notebook with the host as a collaborator; an open-source winner may also make it public.

requirements: One-hour call scheduled by Kaggle with the competition host
Use the Kaggle winner-presentation template when requested
